A '''seismic sensor''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]]. They were fitted on [[Droid/Legends|droids]] such as the [[M38-series explorer droid]],<ref name="RASB" /> and the [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]].<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
